message.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.craft: As your foe falls, a whisper stirs: "Bind a book with the flesh of the dead, and let the Book of Ectcetera reveal what death conceals." (Craft a Book with Rotten Flesh.)
guide.mortal_expansion.ecto_infrastructu: Pipes store 2,000 mB and move 500 mB/t. Purified pipes hold 8,000 mB and move 2,000 mB/t. Branches share limits. Mined tanks and pipes retain fluid.
Ectanks hold 16,000 mB; Purified Ectanks hold 64,000 mB. Craft with eight matching Gravestone around Glass. Buckets move fluid. The glass shows the fill level.
For 16 pipes, use Gravestone in the top and bottom rows, Glass at middle left and right, center empty. Purified Gravestone makes purified pipes.
Empty-hand click a pipe face: Normal, Input, Output, Disabled. Set Input toward the source tank to extract; leave the rest Normal. Disabled blocks flow.
guide.mortal_expansion.grave_porting.pag: Naturalize a Grave bearing your player name. Apply 64 Rotten Flesh to a Bone Block within three blocks of it. Distance includes height.
Right-click a Spiritwell to choose one of your eligible loaded Graves, in any dimension. The Grave and its fully fleshed frame must remain loaded.
A successful port consumes the bone frame and all 64 flesh, adds one personal Haunt point, and keeps the Grave. Leave a safe landing nearby.

message.mortal_expansion.grave_port.fail: The path has closed. Check the Grave, frame and landing space.
guide.mortal_expansion.wisp_o_lantern.pa: At night, Carved Pumpkins in Supernatural or higher Haunt may awaken: a 2% chance per loaded minute. Conversion lowers chunk Haunt by one point.
Every 20 loaded nighttime minutes, a lantern tries to spawn one Ghost if a player is within 32 blocks. Four nearby Ghosts stop more spawning.
Its green face glows faintly. Daylight and unloaded chunks pause the timer. Breaking drops one Carved Pumpkin and one raw Ectoplasm. Silk Touch preserves the lantern instead.
guide.mortal_expansion.mortal_golem.name: Mortal Golem
guide.mortal_expansion.mortal_golem.page: Place a Bone Block. Apply Rotten Flesh to build a body. Each use adds one flesh, up to 64. Lure with Rotten Flesh, Bone or either Ectoplasm.
Appearance changes at 16, 32, 48 and 64 flesh. At least 16 is needed to form. Finish fleshing before adding the lantern head.
Add a Wisp o' Lantern, let a Carved Pumpkin awaken at night, or splash Regeneration on a prepared frame with a Carved Pumpkin. The frame and head become one golem.
Feed Rotten Flesh: damaged golems repair 1/16 health; full-health golems gain one flesh, up to 64. Dead Rising or higher chunk Haunt heals 1% every five seconds.
All awakenings need a clear 3 x 3 area centered on the Bone Block, three blocks tall from its base. Only the frame and head may remain. Keep players and mobs out!
Leave room around and above the frame. Golems hunt undead and intangible mobs. Health: 25/50/75/100. Damage: 0.5/0.75/1/1.25 x Iron Golem.
insight.mortal_expansion.purified_dreamc: Add one Purified Ectothread to a Dreamcatcher in any crafting grid. Or use five Purified Ectothread and four Sticks in the original pattern. While loaded, it catches every good and bad haunt event for its placer, including secret revelations.
message.mortal_expansion.dreamcatcher.ca: Your Dreamcatcher catches a stirring beyond the veil.
insight.mortal_expansion.dreamcatcher.bo: Craft with Sticks in four corners and Ectothread in the other five slots. Hang it on a wall. While loaded, its placer can sleep near monsters. It catches half of all good and bad haunt events. Multiple catchers do not stack.
insight.mortal_expansion.mortality_resea: Use Obsidian and Holy Salt around this book. The book returns intact; study remains to favor later secrets.
Carry even a starting book at Natural personal Haunt. A whisper may reveal your first research secret.

Place a Book of Ectcetera above two Holy Salt with Obsidian between them and three Obsidian beneath. Crafting returns the book intact. Study flesh, bones or either ectoplasm type here to favor later revelations. Later secrets still need an aware or purified book.

insight.mortal_expansion.altar_of_impuri: At Dead Rising personal Haunt, an aware book may reveal the Altar of Impurity.
insight.mortal_expansion.altar_of_purity: Learn Impurity, purify this book, and reach Demonic personal Haunt to reveal the Altar of Purity.
insight.mortal_expansion.altar_of_impuri: Craft a Beacon directly above a Haunt Furnace. Burn offerings in the Altar of Impurity to add 0.10 Haunt to each loaded chunk in its 3x3 area every 10 seconds. Items are consumed every 12.5 seconds and their burn time stacks. Hover over the bonfire for remaining time.
insight.mortal_expansion.altar_of_purity: Craft a Beacon directly above a Haint Furnace. Burn offerings in the Altar of Purity to remove 0.10 Haunt from each loaded chunk in its 3x3 area every 10 seconds. Items are consumed every 12.5 seconds and their burn time stacks. Spirits may gift or bless offerings.

book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.cover:
Book of Ectcetera

A field guide to Mortal Expansion.

By Howierux

Learn the world, prepare for spirits, and make Haunt work for you.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.fir: Craft this book with one Book and one Rotten Flesh, in any arrangement. It starts with the survival chapters.
Learn about Haunt and explore cautiously. The final entry of each tier explains the ingredient for the next upgrade.
Upgrade the same book in order: Bone, Raw Ectoplasm, then Pure Ectoplasm. Each craft consumes one ingredient.
Click chapters in Contents to jump there. Only unlocked chapters appear. Your book keeps its name and other custom properties when upgraded.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.hau: Haunt belongs to chunks and players separately. A chunk is 16 x 16 blocks.
Each named tier holds 10 points. Raising Haunt can improve machines, but also sustain dangerous mobs.

Point bands:
Void: 0-9
Natural: 10-19
Supernatural: 20-29
Dead Rising: 30-39
Demonic: 40-49
Abominable: 50-59
Eldritch: 60-69

Natural baselines:
Spiritwood: Supernatural
Graveyard: Dead Rising
Nether: Demonic
The End: Eldritch
Without a Ward, lowered chunks slowly recover toward their natural baseline.
Loaded chunks get daily spread rolls. Chance rises by tier: 7.5%, 15%, 22.5%, 30%, 37.5%, 45%, 52.5%.
A success adds one point to a random cardinal neighbor, if loaded. Zero Haunt cannot spread.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.per: Killing a mob that Smite does not affect adds 0.01 personal Haunt point. 100 such kills add one point.
Fractions survive death and logout. Killing a Smite-sensitive mob adds nothing.
A haunted player can slowly leak one point into a less-haunted chunk. Wards block this leak in protected chunks.
Breaking a natural Grave adds one personal point. Grave respawns may also have a cost.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.bio: Spiritwood Forest contains spectral trees and unusual leaves. Its natural Haunt floor is Supernatural.
Logs make planks and the usual wooden blocks. Spiritwood recipes use ordinary sticks.
Graveyards have graves, coarse dirt, stone fences and possible mausoleums. Their Haunt floor is Dead Rising.
Most trees generated there are Spiritwood. Respect natural Graves: breaking one raises personal Haunt.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.gra: Craft Graves from Gravestone in a door-shaped pattern. Placement depth follows where you click.
When placing a Grave, inscribe your exact player name to make it your Grave respawn anchor.
A placed Grave used for respawning breaks and adds one personal Haunt point.
At Supernatural or higher, nearby flowers give a placed Grave a 20% daily chance to naturalize, consuming one local point.
A naturalized Grave can remain as a reusable respawn anchor.
Keep the Grave intact and the space above it safe. If your anchor is missing or invalid, ordinary respawn rules apply.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.int: Ghasts, Spirits, Ghosts, Elementals, Haunts and Haints are intangible. Pharaohl can change form.
Use a demi-tangible weapon, spectral arrows or explosions. Ghast fireballs also hurt intangible targets.
Intangible mobs pass upward through ordinary blocks. Spectral ground mobs also pass walls. Tracking allows four occupied block cells.
Floors stop downward motion. Holy Salt, linked Spirit Torches and spectral-solid materials block upward phasing and tracking.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.equ: Bloodstone and Spectralite pickaxes mine faster as they wear, up to 2x. They repair using 0.01 chunk Haunt per durability point. Void prevents repairs.
Gravestone swords are early demi-tangible weapons. Purified swords do 1.5 times the damage against intangible foes.
Each Bloodstone or Spectralite armor piece reduces damage from intangible attackers by 5%. Mixed sets stack to 20%.
Spectralite drops resist fire and lava. Bloodstone and Spectralite shovels cut a 3x3 area along the targeted face. Sneak to mine one block.
Craft Bloodstone gear with normal tool and armor shapes. Hold Spectralite shovel Use for two seconds; release to dig up to 64 connected shovelable blocks.
At a smithing table, combine Bloodstone gear, a Netherite Upgrade template and a Netherite ingot to make matching Spectralite gear.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.ect: Ectoplasm drops from Ghasts, Ghosts, Spirits, Elementals, Haunts and Haints.
Pure Ectoplasm is stronger machine fuel and a purification ingredient. Make it with a heated cauldron or Purification Station.

Purified Gravestone:
Surround one Pure Ectoplasm with eight Gravestone to get eight purified blocks.
Purified Spiritwood has matching building recipes. Check the recipe book for its variants.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.cau: Fill a cauldron completely with water. Place fire, soul fire, lava, or a lit campfire beneath it.
Add Ectoplasm to make Liquid Ectoplasm, or Grave Moss to make Holy Water.
Add Grave Moss to heated Liquid Ectoplasm, or Ectoplasm to heated Holy Water, to make Purified Ectoplasm fluid.
Right-click or drop ingredients in. Each reaction consumes only one ingredient.
Use buckets or fluid pipes to move cauldron liquids.
Smelt Liquid Ectoplasm buckets into Ectoplasm, Holy Water buckets into Holy Salt, and Purified Ectoplasm buckets into Pure Ectoplasm.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.sal: Smelt a Holy Water bucket to obtain Holy Salt. Place it as a line on supported ground.
Every salt column projects a full-height wall against intangible mobs. Ordinary redstone does not power the salt circuit.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.tor: Craft a Spirit Torch with Holy Salt above a stick. It powers Holy Salt instead of ordinary redstone.
Torches sharing X or Z link across up to 64 horizontal blocks. Links project full-height intangible barriers.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.san: Close a boundary with Holy Salt, Spirit Torch links, or both. Mobs inside gain Sanctified.
Smite-sensitive mobs take one damage every two seconds. An open boundary stops refreshing the effect.
Enclosures use horizontal columns, regardless of height. A lone torch is not a wall; linked endpoints are required.
Keep the area loaded. Interiors above 4,096 columns cannot sanctify. An Altar of Purity burns offerings to cleanse a 3x3 chunk area.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.war:
Wards keep their 3 x 3 cleansing area loaded and ticking, even when players leave.

Chunkloading resumes after a restart.
Protected loaded chunks lose one Haunt point per day. Wards block incoming and outgoing spread and player leakage. Overlapping Wards do not stack.

Ward recipe:
Grave Moss in four corners; Purified Spiritwood Planks in the remaining five slots.

Break a Ward to release its tickets. Other Wards keep their own.

Wards cleanse below natural floors. Without protection, Haunt slowly recovers.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.ect: Feed the Ectchantment Machine Ectoplasm or FE power.
One operation costs 4,000 ectoplasmic charge or 40,000 FE. Ectoplasm gives 1,000 charge; Pure Ectoplasm gives 4,000.

Transmutations:
Diamond -> Bloodstone
Stone -> Gravestone
Other logs -> Spiritwood
Other saplings -> Spiritwood Sapling
Vines, Moss Blocks or Glow Lichen -> Grave Moss
Suitable weapons and tools can gain Demi-Tangible, letting them hurt intangible mobs.
Matching stackable outputs merge up to their stack limit. Clear blocked output space before processing can continue.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.gen: The Ectoplasmic Generator burns Ectoplasm for FE. Pure Ectoplasm gives more energy over a longer burn.
Output improves with local Haunt. Completed raw burns add 1 chunk Haunt; pure burns add 3. Adjacent machines and cables receive power.
Open the Enchantment Generator and place an enchanted item in its left slot. It extracts FE, then returns the disenchanted item in the right slot.
When extraction finishes, retrieve the disenchanted item with an empty hand. It generates power; processing machines only accept power.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.sta: Supply one Ectoplasm, one Grave Moss or Holy Salt, one bucket of water (1,000 mB), and 100,000 FE.
The Station makes one Pure Ectoplasm in three seconds. Each completed craft adds one local Haunt point.
Insert water buckets beneath the tank or pipe water into it. Compatible item pipes can move ingredients and outputs.
Keep output space clear and provide enough FE to complete purification.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.fur:
Haunt Furnace: ring of eight Gravestone.
Haint Furnace: ring of eight Purified Gravestone.
Both smelt normal furnace recipes with ordinary fuels. Their speed follows the chunk's Haunt tier.

Speeds by tier:
Void: 1x
Natural: 2.5x
Supernatural: 4x
Dead Rising: 5.5x
Demonic: 7x
Abominable: 8.5x
Eldritch: 10x
Haint pauses burn time whenever cooking stalls. At Demonic or higher, active cooking also preserves burn time.
It still needs an initial fuel item. Tier changes update its rules while preserving cooking completion.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.cre: Mortal Expansion adds Spirits, Ghosts, Phantoms, Elementals, Haunts, Haints, Mummies and Pharaohl.
All are affected by Smite. Intangible creatures still require damage that can reach them.
At Supernatural or higher, Mortal Expansion mobs, Zombies and Skeletons resist sunlight burning.
During daylight they seek sustaining Haunt or shelter. Stronger spectral mobs may require higher tiers for their preferred refuge.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.sce: Pharaohl drops a scepter. Each use summons two allied Mummies and spends one of 12 charges. It starts empty.
Cooldown: 15 seconds. In your inventory, hold ectoplasm on the cursor and right-click the scepter. Each raw adds 4 charges; one purified fills all 12.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.gra: Spirit Journey is a death-screen choice if your selected self-named Grave is valid. It starts spectator flight at the Grave.
With a valid self-Grave, death items wait for your choice. Ordinary Respawn drops them where you died.
Spirit Journey leaves a corpse and holds items across logout. Return within two blocks to revive and recover them. Grayscale and spirit barriers are planned.
Keep Inventory and Curse of Vanishing still apply. Without a valid self-Grave, death drops work normally.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.spi: Spiritwells rarely appear over open Overworld land as faint floating Nether Stars. During Spirit Journey, a pale beacon beam marks each loaded well.
You can walk through a Spiritwell, but cannot place blocks within two blocks of it. Pistons cannot push blocks into that space.
At Dead Rising, haunting can release a Ghost at a well. A missing well holds the event until a player is within 100 blocks of one.
message.mortal_expansion.holy_water_bles: Holy Water protects you from haunting for 60 seconds.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.per: Ambient Haunt effects use your personal tier. Checks occur every 30 seconds; an event starts a 60-second cooldown.
Natural can bring quiet sounds or a passive Spirit. Supernatural adds fleeting shadows, brief slowing, and curated potion effects.
Demonic can safely shove you one block or swap two occupied main-inventory slots. Hotbar, armor, and offhand stay untouched.
At Supernatural, haunting may finish one nearby cooking recipe or convert one carried plank or cobblestone into its spectral form.
Holy Water grants 60 seconds of protection and removes one personal point per minute. Wards also suppress negative ambient effects.

Event chance per check:
Natural: 2%
Supernatural: 5%
Dead Rising: 8%
Demonic: 12%
Abominable: 16%
Eldritch: 20%

book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.unl: Kill a Skeleton to obtain a Bone. Craft one Bone with this book, in any arrangement, to unlock graves and spirits.
Gather Gravestone in a Graveyard. Craft a sword with two Gravestone above a Stick. It can hurt intangible enemies.
Hunt a Ghost with that sword for Raw Ectoplasm. Craft one Raw Ectoplasm with this book to unlock spectral materials.
Heat a full water cauldron. Add Raw Ectoplasm, then Grave Moss, to make Purified Ectoplasm fluid.
Collect the purified fluid in a bucket and smelt it into Pure Ectoplasm. Craft one Pure Ectoplasm with this book to unlock the final chapters.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.gho: Use Ectothread in normal armor patterns to craft Ghost Garb. Its recipe is learned through a Spectral Insight, not by merely holding the material.
A full garb set lets you pass through walls and blocks negative haunt effects. Ghost Garb has leather defense and iron durability.
Inside walls, your air drains as underwater. Respiration slows the drain. Ghost and Haint garb do not prevent drowning damage, either in water or inside walls.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.hai: Eight String around Pure Ectoplasm make eight Purified Ectothread. Craft Haint Garb with normal armor patterns.
In smithing, add Pure Ectoplasm to a Ghost Garb part to upgrade it. Leave the template slot empty. Full Haint sets gain a powerful jump boost.
Combine a Haint part with its matching Spectralite part in smithing, without a template. It keeps spectral armor protection and garb abilities.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.mas: Purification is not the end. Combine this book with a Ritual Star to awaken the Darkhold. All dead secrets yield, but carrying it draws your own Haunt beyond Eldritch.

Bulbs by tier: Void 0; Natural 1; Supernatural 2; Dead Rising 3; Demonic 4; Abominable 5; Eldritch 6. The basic reader shows bulbs on its face without a HUD.
Craft a reader with one Raw Ectoplasm to make a Precise EMF Reader. Digits show hundredths of chunk or personal Haunt. Hold Use for personal readings.

book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.hau: Benefits and risks roll separately every 30 seconds. Each pool has a 60-second cooldown. Personal Haunt sets eligibility; higher tiers retain earlier effects.
Helpful whispers point toward nearby moss or graves. At Demonic Haunt, spectral melee weapons may gain 25% damage for 20 seconds. Chat hints announce successful effects.
Risks include footsteps, false figures and hostile visitors. At higher Haunt, spirits may notice you farther away or pursue you. Haunted furnaces may pause briefly.
Veil breaches give a five-second warning. Full garb, blessings and wards block risks. Nearby altars may receive salt or a blessing for their next offering.

book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.spi: Pass within 20 blocks of a Spiritwell or Cemetery to discover it. Each site has a stable name. Discoveries survive death and logout. Use /spectralsites to list them.
At Supernatural Haunt or higher, Second Sight may show spectral footprints for 30 seconds. They point to the nearest recorded undiscovered site in this dimension.

insight.mortal_expansion.ghost_garb.guid: Ectothread is known. Craft a supply, then carry me at Dead Rising personal Haunt to discover Ghost Garb.
insight.mortal_expansion.haint_garb.guid: Ghost Garb is known. Prepare Pure Ectoplasm. At Demonic personal Haunt, I may reveal its finer weaving.
insight.mortal_expansion.spectralite_hai: Upgrade me with Pure Ectoplasm. At Abominable personal Haunt, I may reveal how Haint Garb joins Spectralite.

insight.mortal_expansion.spectralite_hai: A stronger armor secret remains hidden. Upgrade me with Pure Ectoplasm and carry me at Abominable personal Haunt.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.ins: Ectoplasm awakens me. Personal Haunt reveals secrets one at a time. A Mortality Research Station favors the next revelation; its crafting preserves this book.
I will recommend your next step as I remember new secrets. Knowledge survives death. A learned book can teach another player.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.ect: Place eight String around one Raw Ectoplasm to weave eight Ectothread. Ghost Garb is another secret, revealed at Dead Rising personal Haunt.
book.mortal_expansion.ectcetera.page.equ: Spectralite hoes grow crops on right-click, costing one chunk Haunt per bonemeal pulse. Both spectral hoes make reactive farmland; Dead Rising keeps it moist.

tooltip.mortal_expansion.shovel.charge: Hold Use %s seconds; release to dig up to %s connected blocks
tooltip.mortal_expansion.pickaxe.repair: Repairs draw %s chunk Haunt; faster at higher tiers, disabled at Void
tooltip.mortal_expansion.axe.tree: Fells connected tree logs; sneak to cut one log

jei.mortal_expansion.secret_hint: The dead guard this knowledge. Learn this recipe through Secrets of the Dead in the Book of Ectcetera. Viewing it here does not teach it.
jei.mortal_expansion.charge_fuel: Charge fuel: 4 Raw Ectoplasm or 1 Purified Ectoplasm per operation. FE is an alternative.
jei.mortal_expansion.bucket_return: Water is consumed; the bucket is returned.
jei.mortal_expansion.cauldron_heat: Full cauldron with a heat source below. Add one reagent.
jei.mortal_expansion.cauldron_buckets: Buckets depict fluids. Collect the result with an empty bucket; containers are reused.
jei.mortal_expansion.book_info: Craft a Book with Rotten Flesh. Upgrade in order with Bone, Raw Ectoplasm, then solid Purified Ectoplasm. Secret recipes still need Spectral Insight revelations, even when visible in JEI.
jei.mortal_expansion.generator_info: Burns raw or purified ectoplasm to produce FE. Completed burns add 1 or 3 chunk Haunt respectively. Output depends on chunk Haunt.
jei.mortal_expansion.furnace_info: Smelts normal furnace recipes. Needs starting fuel; preserves remaining burn time at Demonic chunk Haunt or higher. Below Demonic, burn time falls only while cooking advances.
darkhold.mortal_expansion.darkhold.name: Secrets of the Damned
A Ritual Star offered to the purified Book of Ectcetera tears its final binding. The Darkhold reveals every Secret of the Dead at once. Its new chapter belongs to things that never rested.

Carry this volume and your personal Haunt rises by 0.01 every ten seconds, even within a backpack. Extra copies do not hasten it. At 70 Haunt, the first damned secret speaks. Removing the book stops its influence; knowledge remains.
darkhold.mortal_expansion.demons.name: Beyond the Veil: Demons
darkhold.mortal_expansion.demons.locked: Carry the Darkhold with at least 70 personal Haunt to hear this secret.
darkhold.mortal_expansion.demons.page.1: The first Darkhold awakens Demons. They may emerge in dark places where chunk Haunt is Demonic or higher. Until this secret is revealed to you, they remain unseen. Their colored Ghost-like forms are stronger, swifter hunters.
darkhold.mortal_expansion.demons.page.2: Demons pass through ordinary blocks and resist mundane harm. Demi-tangible or magical attacks can strike them. They leave Demonic Ash behind. An EMF reader marks Haunt beyond Eldritch with red bulbs, then dark purple; the precise reader shows the full value.
darkhold.mortal_expansion.revealed: The Darkhold shudders. Something beyond the veil has noticed you. A secret of the Damned is revealed.
darkhold.mortal_expansion.demons.page.3:
Seven sins mark their forms:
Indigo: Pride, crowned horns.
Green: Envy, narrow eyes.
Orange: Gluttony, broad jaw.
Red: Wrath, heavy horns.
Blue: Sloth, drooping gaze.
Yellow: Greed, coin ornaments.
Violet: Lust, swept horns.
